name: 16 CFR Part 312, Children's Online Privacy Protection Rule
issuer: US Federal Trade Commission (Office of the Federal Register, GPO)
edition: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 16, revised as of January 1, 2026
statement: The COPPA Rule as codified in the official annual CFR edition in GPO's XML form, including the 2025 amendments: definitions, notice, verifiable parental consent, mixed audience services, data retention and safe harbor programs. Index row R02.
